ln=B.strip().split("\n"); cols=ln[0].split(); M={}
for x in ln[1:]:
    p=x.split()
    for c,v in zip(cols,p[1:]): M[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
def sw(q,t,gap=-9):
    n,m=len(q),len(t); H=[[0]*(m+1) for _ in range(n+1)]; P=[[0]*(m+1) for _ in range(n+1)]; best=(0,0,0)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        qi=q[i-1]; Hi=H[i]; Hp=H[i-1]; Pi=P[i]; row=[M.get((qi,c),-1) for c in t]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            d=Hp[j-1]+row[j-1]; u=Hp[j]+gap; l=Hi[j-1]+gap
            v=d; p=1
            if u>v: v,p=u,2
            if l>v: v,p=l,3
            if v<0: v,p=0,0
            Hi[j]=v; Pi[j]=p
            if v>best[0]: best=(v,i,j)
    s,i,j=best; mp={}
    while i>0 and j>0 and H[i][j]>0:
        p=P[i][j]
        if p==1: mp[i]=j; i-=1; j-=1
        elif p==2: mp[i]=None; i-=1
        elif p==3: j-=1
        else: break
    return s,mp

SUB={"cd17663":("Oca6 (cd17663)",OCA6,105,131,114,200),
     "cd14528":("Siw14/Oca3 (cd14528)",SIW14,205,231,214,90),
     "cd14531":("Oca1 (cd14531)",SIW14,205,231,214,90)}
rows=[]
for cd,(lab,qseq,qs,qe,cpos,nmax) in SUB.items():
    r=S.get(f"https://www.ebi.ac.uk/interpro/api/protein/UniProt/entry/cdd/{cd}/",params={"page_size":200},timeout=120)
    accs=[x["metadata"]["accession"] for x in r.json()["results"]][:nmax]
    recs={}
    for i in range(0,len(accs),90):
        rr=S.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/accessions",
                 params={"accessions":",".join(accs[i:i+90]),"format":"json",
                         "fields":"accession,organism_name,lineage,sequence"},timeout=120)
        for e in rr.json()["results"]:
            recs[e["primaryAccession"]]=dict(org=e.get("organism",{}).get("scientificName",""),
                                             lin=list(e.get("organism",{}).get("lineage",[])),
                                             seq=e["sequence"]["value"])
    Q=qseq[qs-1:qe]
    for acc,v in recs.items():
        s,mp=sw(Q,v["seq"])
        if s<45: continue
        def res(pos):
            j=mp.get(pos-qs+1); return (v["seq"][j-1],j) if j else ("-",None)
        c,ci=res(cpos); r7,_=res(cpos+6); st8,_=res(cpos+7)
        rows.append(dict(subfamily=lab,acc=acc,org=v["org"][:40],
                         kingdom=("Fungi" if "Fungi" in v["lin"] else ("Viridiplantae" if "Viridiplantae" in v["lin"] else "other")),
                         sw=s,cat_Cys=c,pos_R=r7,pos_ST=st8,
                         window=v["seq"][max(0,ci-8):ci+9] if ci else ""))
df=pd.DataFrame(rows)
summary=[]
for sf,g in df.groupby("subfamily"):
    summary.append(dict(subfamily=sf,n=len(g),
        pct_Cys=round(100*(g.cat_Cys=="C").mean(),1),
        pct_Arg_at_R=round(100*(g.pos_R=="R").mean(),1),
        pct_basic_at_R=round(100*g.pos_R.isin(list("RKH")).mean(),1),
        pct_ST_at_plus7=round(100*g.pos_ST.isin(["S","T"]).mean(),1),
        R_pos_residues=", ".join(f"{k}:{v}" for k,v in g.pos_R.value_counts().head(5).items())))
sumdf=pd.DataFrame(summary).set_index("subfamily")
pd.set_option("display.width",300); pd.set_option("display.max_columns",30)
print(sumdf.to_string()); print()
print(df[df.acc.isin(["Q12454","P53965","P50946"])][["subfamily","acc","org","cat_Cys","pos_R","pos_ST","window"]].to_string(index=False))
print()
print("Fisher test, Arg-at-R-position Oca6 vs Siw14 subfamilies:")
from scipy.stats import fisher_exact
a=(df[df.subfamily.str.startswith("Oca6")].pos_R=="R").sum(); na=(df.subfamily.str.startswith("Oca6")).sum()
b=(df[df.subfamily.str.startswith("Siw14")].pos_R=="R").sum(); nb=(df.subfamily.str.startswith("Siw14")).sum()
orr,p=fisher_exact([[a,na-a],[b,nb-b]])
print(f"  Oca6 {a}/{na} vs Siw14 {b}/{nb}  OR={orr:.3g}  p={p:.3g}")

order=[i for i in ["Siw14/Oca3 (cd14528)","Oca1 (cd14531)","Oca6 (cd17663)"] if i in sumdf.index]

for k,(lab,key,col) in enumerate([("catalytic Cys","pct_Cys","#4C72B0"),

                                  ("Ser/Thr at +7","pct_ST_at_plus7","#55A868")]):
    vals=[sumdf.loc[o,key] for o in order]
    bb=ax.bar(x+(k-1)*w,vals,w,label=lab,color=col); ax.bar_label(bb,fmt="%.0f",fontsize=8)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels([o.replace(" (","\n(") for o in order],fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("% of subfamily members"); ax.set_ylim(0,115)
ax.set_title("P-loop conservation across three PFA-DSP subfamilies")
